description.value:
Cost 3 Zeal

Range 60 feet

Targets 1 creature

Frequency once per day

Saving Throw Will

Curse a target's next several rolls.

The target must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or its next three checks, attack rolls, or saving throws (its choice of which, as each comes up) each take a -2 circumstance penalty (-4 on a critical failure). On a success, only its next one such roll is penalized, at -2. The house always collects, eventually.
